description: NaAsH₄O₅ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/m space group. Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent AsO₄ tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.39-2.56 Å. As is bonded to four O atoms to form AsO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 37-52°. There are a spread of As-O bond distances ranging from 1.68-1.76 Å. There are three inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.02 Å) and one longer (1.63 Å) H-O bond length. In the second H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 1.00 Å. In the third H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.99 Å. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one As, and one H atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and one As atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to one As and two equivalent H atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to two equivalent Na and two H atoms.
